mainEntity.name: Is Generative Engine Optimization suitable for new cosmetic surgery practices or only established ones?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generative Engine Optimization is beneficial for both new and established cosmetic surgery practices. For new practices, it provides a powerful way to quickly build an online presence and establish authority in a competitive market. Established practices can leverage GEO to expand their reach, target new patient segments, and maintain a competitive edge by consistently delivering fresh, relevant content that adapts to evolving patient needs and search algorithms.
acceptedAnswer.description: GEO benefits both new and established practices; new ones can quickly build an online presence, while established ones can expand reach and maintain competitiveness.
